_review.scope: Authorized journal articles coar:c_6501; separate from unchanged thesis contract and from the _created date plan (sonar-articles-plan.json, not executable). Prior source report 309816, not a current expected saved count.
_review.sorting_key: Segments are disjoint pid ranges (q=pid:[lo TO hi], both ends inclusive), bisected until the reported hits.total.value is <= hidden_cap 9800. sort=oldest is an API keyword; backing field and tie-break not verified, but ties inside a range of <=9800 only matter if the order is unstable between pages.
_review.unique_secondary_key_api_support: 확인 못 함; do not invent sort=id or a secondary-sort parameter
_review.same_date_risk_basis: Not a split-key risk: ranges are by pid, which is unique per document. Page-order stability inside one range is a separate unverified risk (see required_preflight). pid ranges replace _created ranges because _created is the migration time (2021: 306533 records, 2021-02: 298767).
_review.required_preflight: Before any server run, on a frozen range of at most 9800 records (for example one leaf-sized pid range), compare sort=oldest against sort=newest over every page: raw count, unique ids, reported total. Also confirm numeric (not lexicographic) range semantics: for pid:[a TO b] every returned metadata.pid must lie numerically in [a,b], and two adjacent ranges must sum to their union's total.
_review.reconciliation: overall_total_check=true, leaf reported totals summed versus unique listed ids, overlap between leaves, and per-leaf reported total versus unique ids are mandatory; any mismatch, cap_unsplittable or unverified status is not collection completion
_review.note: Review metadata is descriptive, not an execution gate; do not run this candidate before preflight.
_review.record_scope_requirement: metadata.documentType must be the exact string coar:c_6501. Shape not verified against live response; unknown/mismatched types fail closed.
_review.identity_and_dates: Reuse registered pid fallback, URLs, published/created raw dates and skip rules (_parse_article_search_results/_paper_from_article_result unchanged). Only category changes to coar:c_6501.
_review.state_isolation: Both plans reuse registered site_id sonar-ch-global and host sonar.ch. Use separate state files/output directories, a shared host gate, and sequential runs; do not reuse thesis checkpoints or run scopes concurrently.
_review.pid_range_evidence: precheck 2026-10-13: pid:[0 TO 250000]=166263 and pid:[250001 TO 9999999]=143553, sum 309816 = unfiltered total. A complementary lexicographic split would also sum exactly, so this does not prove numeric comparison; the overall/leaf-sum/overlap checks fail closed if it is not numeric.
_review.estimated_requests: Synthetic assumptions only; the real pid distribution is not measured. With T=309816 and cap 9800 there are at least 32 leaves. Three synthetic distributions (uniform over 0..465800, 166263 below 250000 plus a sparse tail to 9999999, uniform over 0..9999999) give 32-53 leaf ranges and 6337-6409 requests: per non-empty leaf ceil(T_leaf/50) pages + 3 end-confirmation reads (empty page twice, then the next page), one probe per split range, 2 per empty range, robots and the overall total; about 2.65 h at 1.5 s. Heavier clustering adds only split probes. The deepest page read is 198 (window 9900 < 10000). Under max_requests 20000 and max_runtime_s 21600.
